---
title: "Babies Named Tristan (1926–2025)"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)

# 100-year window
years <- 1926:2025

# Read and combine records for "Tristan" across all 100 years
tristan_data <- map_dfr(years, \(y) {
  file <- sprintf("data/yob%d.txt", y)
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(tibble())
  read_csv(file, col_names = c("name", "sex", "n"), col_types = "cci", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
    filter(name == "Tristan") |> 
    mutate(year = y)
})

# Yearly totals
tristan_totals <- tristan_data |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarize(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

# Plot with annotation for Legends of the Fall release
ggplot(tristan_totals, aes(x = year, y = total)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2b5c8f", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1994, linetype = "dashed", color = "#c93b27") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1994,
    y = 5600,
    label = "Legends of the Fall (1994)\nBrad Pitt stars as Tristan",
    hjust = 1.05,
    size = 3.5,
    color = "#c93b27"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named Tristan (1926–2025)",
    subtitle = "Popularity spiked nearly 10x after the 1994 film Legends of the Fall",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    caption = "Source: US Social Security Administration"
  )
```

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
### *Legends of the Fall* and the 1995 Spike

In December 1994, the film ***Legends of the Fall*** was released in theaters, starring Brad Pitt as the passionate lead character **Tristan Ludlow**. 

Before the film (1994), only 588 babies in the US were named Tristan. By 1996, that number surged to **5,844** — an almost tenfold increase!

![Brad Pitt as Tristan in *Legends of the Fall*](legends_of_the_fall.gif){width=500px}
:::
